Title: Announcing Try Azure Cosmos DB support in Vercel Integration

Body.Content:
You can now easily create free Azure Cosmos DB accounts within the integration with Vercel and upgrade if needed. This improves productivity as you can deploy a Vercel application and create a free Azure Cosmos DB account with a database during the deployment process.

Learn more.
